subject: general
question: Who works to make 'Made in India' a label of quality?
solution:
The correct answer is **3) India Brand Equity Foundation**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Promoting Indian Brands:** India Brand Equity Foundation (IBEF) is a government-backed organization that works to promote Indian brands and products globally. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• **Enhancing Brand Image:** IBEF aims to enhance the perception of "Made in India" products by focusing on quality, innovation, and sustainability. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• **Various Initiatives:** IBEF undertakes various initiatives, such as branding campaigns, market research, and policy advocacy, to improve the brand image of Indian products. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• **Global Recognition:** Through its efforts, IBEF strives to make "Made in India" a label of quality and recognition worldwide. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Annamrita Foundation:** Annamrita Foundation is a non-profit organization that provides mid-day meals to school children. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• **National Innovation Foundation:** The National Innovation Foundation is a government organization that supports and promotes grassroots innovation.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• **Diya Foundation:** Diya Foundation is a non-profit organization that works for the welfare of children and women.
